Expected: One solid; the torus swallows one turn of the coil. Volume must be less than 2368.705 + 1776.529 = 4145.234 and greater than 2368.705.

Actual (before the fix): solid.boolean union failed with 'Error in the application.' after about 0.9 s. This was the fastest reproduction of the tangency/coincidence crash.
